name: Picture swarm
doc: A flock of up to 400k birds that paints the picture: each bird is a soft streak in the picture's colour where it flies, the flock aligns and coheres on a coarse grid, and eight luma sensors pull every bird toward the bright parts, where it slows and lingers, so the swarm gathers into the picture's light. The bass sets the cruising speed, the mids stir the wander, the beat makes the flock hungrier, onsets blast it open from a seeded spot and fatten the birds.

in.doc: the picture: bird colours, e.g. core-media.out

luma.doc: brightness the flock flies to; from the picture when unwired

grid.doc: flocking grid height in cells (neighbourhood size)

speed.doc: cruising speed in screen heights per second (the bass adds to it)

alignment.doc: steer toward the mean heading around

food.doc: pull toward the bright parts of the picture

hunger.doc: the beat makes the flock hungrier

reach.doc: luma sensor distance in screen heights

contrast.doc: gamma on the brightness (higher = only the brightest parts draw them)

settle.doc: how much bright parts slow them (they linger there)

wander.doc: noise steering (the mids add to it)

react.doc: how much the music drives speed, wander and hunger
